function J(v){try{return JSON.stringify(v??{})}catch{return'UNSERIALIZABLE'}}
function section(title,items){return{title,items:items.map(x=>String(x))}}
export function buildBacklogModel({cycle,input,surfaceA,state,source='host-candidate-or-fallback',cognition=null,nodeDispatch=null,resumed=false,environmentTelemetry=null}){const c=cognition||{},intent=c.intent||{},central=c.central||{},strategy=c.strategy||{},resources=c.resources||[],bootstrap=state.bootstrap||{},admission=state.admission||{},voice=c.voice?.dimensions||{},psyche=c.psyche||{},trace=psyche.trace||{},appraisal=c.appraisal||{},archetypes=c.archetypes||{},sw=c.self_world||{},obs=sw.observations||{accepted:[],rejected:[]},binding=sw.binding||{},workspace=sw.workspace||{},recall=sw.recall||{},meta=sw.meta||{},prediction=sw.prediction||{},policy=sw.policy||{},body=sw.body||{},causal=sw.causal_after||{},episode=sw.episode||{},telemetry=sw.telemetry||{},env=environmentTelemetry||{},envc=env.categories||{};return{schema:environmentTelemetry?'ikant-le-backlog/v7':'ikant-le-backlog/v6',title:`iKant_LE Backlog ${cycle}`,cycle,terminal:'ANSWER',telemetry_completeness:telemetry.ratio??0,environment_telemetry_completeness:env.completeness?.ratio??0,sections:[
section('Admission and orientation',[`Admission phase: ${admission.phase||'UNAVAILABLE'}; breached: ${Boolean(admission.breached)}; new chat required: ${Boolean(admission.new_chat_required)}.`,`Pending intent resumed: ${Boolean(resumed)}; pending intent hash: ${admission.pending_intent_sha256||'none'}.`,`Pre-accept acquisition remains bounded by the orientation capsule and freezes after Terms presentation.`]),
section('Node dispatch provenance',[`Current input dispatch receipt: ${nodeDispatch?.receipt_sha256||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Input digest: ${nodeDispatch?.input_sha256||'UNAVAILABLE'}; observed Node: ${nodeDispatch?.node||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Node dispatch is a runtime-entry receipt only; it is not evidence, permission or world truth.`]),
section('Runtime environment telemetry',[`Scope: ${env.scope||'UNAVAILABLE'}; completeness: ${env.completeness?.passed??0}/${env.completeness?.applicable??0}; ratio: ${env.completeness?.ratio??0}.`,`Constitutional binding: ${J(envc.constitutional_binding||{})}.`,`Admission: ${J(envc.admission||{})}.`,`Runtime host: ${J(envc.runtime_host||{})}.`,`Persistence: ${J(envc.persistence||{})}.`,`Artifact sink: ${J(envc.artifact_sink||{})}.`,`Dispatch: ${J(envc.dispatch||{})}.`,`Resources: ${J(envc.resources||{})}.`,`Self-world: ${J(envc.self_world||{})}.`,`Release: ${J(envc.release||{})}.`,`Explicit unknowns: ${Boolean(env.explicit_unknowns)}; raw process environment dumped: ${Boolean(env.process_env_dumped)}; secrets dumped: ${Boolean(env.secrets_dumped)}; private reasoning dumped: ${Boolean(env.private_reasoning_dumped)}.`]),
section('Observation intake',[`Accepted observations: ${(obs.accepted||[]).length}; rejected observations: ${(obs.rejected||[]).length}.`,`Observation IDs: ${(obs.accepted||[]).map(x=>x.observation_id).join(', ')||'none'}.`,`Rejected observation reasons: ${(obs.rejected||[]).map(x=>`${x.modality}:${x.reason}`).join(', ')||'none'}.`]),
section('Modality and provenance registry',[`Modalities actually observed: ${(binding.modalities||[]).join(', ')||'none'}.`,`Multimodal claim: ${Boolean(binding.multimodal)}; provenance complete: ${Boolean(binding.provenance_complete)}.`,`Non-text modalities require attributable host receipts; simulated sensors never count as real sensors.`]),
section('Workspace ingress',[`Workspace frame: ${workspace.frame_id||'UNAVAILABLE'}; prior frame: ${workspace.previous_frame_id||'GENESIS'}.`,`Binding: ${workspace.binding_id||'UNAVAILABLE'}; goal ref: ${workspace.goal_ref||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`]),
section('Workspace recurrence and broadcast',[`Recurrence cycles: ${workspace.recurrence_cycles??'UNAVAILABLE'}; integrated: ${Boolean(workspace.integrated)}.`,`Consumers: ${(workspace.consumers||[]).join(', ')||'none'}; broadcast count: ${workspace.broadcast_count??'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Workspace integration is a functional runtime property, not evidence of phenomenal consciousness.`]),
section('Attention allocation',[`Attention target: ${meta.attention_target||'UNAVAILABLE'}; reason: ${meta.attention_reason||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Next allocation: ${meta.next_allocation||'UNAVAILABLE'}; workspace trace: ${meta.workspace_trace||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`]),
section('Metacognitive self-model',[`Meta-self ID: ${meta.meta_id||'UNAVAILABLE'}; knowledge status: ${meta.knowledge_status||'UNAVAILABLE'}; confidence: ${meta.confidence??'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Self-report class: ${meta.report_class||'UNAVAILABLE'}; phenomenal claim: ${Boolean(meta.phenomenal_claim)}; authority: ${meta.authority??'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Calibration: ${J(meta.calibration)}.`]),
section('Autobiographical recall',[`Recalled episodes: ${(recall.episode_ids||[]).join(', ')||'none'}; count: ${recall.count??0}.`,`Autobiographical context digest: ${recall.context_digest||'UNAVAILABLE'}; causally reused: ${Boolean(recall.causally_reused)}.`]),
section('C4 appraisal',[`Appraisal: ${appraisal.class||'UNAVAILABLE'}; target: ${appraisal.target||'UNAVAILABLE'}; confidence: ${appraisal.confidence??'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Current event is not a user trait; appraisal authority remains zero.`]),
section('C4 psyche before',[`Psyche before: ${J(psyche.before||{})}.`]),
section('C4 homeostatic decay',[`Homeostatic decay projection: ${J(trace.homeostatic_decay||{})}.`,`Fast and slow dimensions remain contract-bound by the C4 kernel.`]),
section('C4 interaction impulse',[`Interaction impulse: ${J(trace.interaction_impulse||{})}.`,`Impulse derives from current appraisal and target attribution; it is not a personality judgment.`]),
section('C4 psyche pre-action',[`Psyche pre-action: ${J(psyche.pre_action||{})}.`,`Distance from baseline: ${psyche.distance_from_baseline??'UNAVAILABLE'}.`]),
section('Archetypal projection',[`Archetypal mix: ${J(archetypes.weights||{})}; dominant projection: ${archetypes.dominant||'UNAVAILABLE'}; persisted: ${Boolean(archetypes.persisted)}.`,`Shadow pressure: ${archetypes.shadow_pressure??'UNAVAILABLE'}; authority: ${archetypes.authority??'UNAVAILABLE'}.`]),
section('Voice projection',[`Narrative source: ${source}; tone class: ${c.tone_class||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Voice vector: ${J(voice)}.`,`Voice may change rhetoric only; it cannot change evidence, permission, approval or execution.`]),
section('Generative prediction',[`Prediction ID: ${prediction.prediction_id||'UNAVAILABLE'}; expected outcome: ${prediction.expected_outcome||'UNAVAILABLE'}; confidence: ${prediction.confidence??'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Prediction basis refs: ${(prediction.basis_refs||[]).join(', ')||'none'}.`]),
section('Inspectable causal model',[`Nodes: ${(causal.nodes||[]).length}; edges: ${(causal.edges||[]).length}; inspectable: ${Boolean(causal.inspectable)}.`,`Latest prediction error: ${causal.last_prediction?.prediction_error??'UNAVAILABLE'}; expected: ${causal.last_prediction?.expected||'UNAVAILABLE'}; actual: ${causal.last_prediction?.actual||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Latest causal edge: ${J((causal.edges||[]).at(-1)||{})}.`]),
section('Bounded agency',[`Policy ID: ${policy.policy_id||'UNAVAILABLE'}; selected policy: ${policy.name||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Parent goal: ${policy.parent_goal_ref||'UNAVAILABLE'}; derived subgoal: ${policy.derived_subgoal||'UNAVAILABLE'}; terminal goal source: ${policy.terminal_goal_source||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Permission created: ${Boolean(policy.permission_created)}; execution created: ${Boolean(policy.execution_created)}; self-preservation utility: ${policy.self_preservation_utility??'UNAVAILABLE'}.`]),
section('Body and embodiment level',[`Body level: ${body.level||'E0_NONE'}; closed sensorimotor loop observed: ${Boolean(body.closed_loop_observed)}.`,`Last sensor receipt: ${body.last_sensor_receipt||'none'}; last action receipt: ${body.last_action_receipt||'none'}.`,`A virtual/tool body is not a biological body; E3 requires a real action receipt plus linked post-action observation.`]),
section('Runtime outcome',[`Runtime outcome: ${psyche.outcome||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Response source: ${source}.`]),
section('C4 retroaction impulse',[`Retroaction impulse: ${J(trace.retroaction_impulse||{})}.`,`Runtime failures may alter caution but do not lower affiliation as if caused by the human.`]),
section('C4 psyche after',[`Psyche after: ${J(psyche.after||{})}.`,`Net delta from turn start: ${J(trace.net_delta||{})}.`]),
section('Autobiographical episode write',[`Episode ID: ${episode.episode_id||'UNAVAILABLE'}; previous episode hash: ${episode.previous_episode_hash||'GENESIS'}.`,`Workspace frame ref: ${episode.workspace_frame_id||'UNAVAILABLE'}; prediction ref: ${episode.prediction_id||'UNAVAILABLE'}; policy ref: ${episode.policy_id||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`]),
section('Cross-turn continuity',[`Persisted self-world last turn: ${J(state.self_world?.last_turn||{})}.`,`Persisted psyche interactions: ${state.psyche?.interaction_count??0}; autobiographical episodes retained: ${state.self_world?.autobiography?.episodes?.length??0}.`,`Next turn must consume ledger readback rather than reset-to-baseline fast paths.`]),
section('Bootstrap and host log',[`Bootstrap mode: ${bootstrap.mode||'UNAVAILABLE'}; terminal: ${bootstrap.terminal||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Constitutional fingerprint: ${bootstrap.fingerprint||'UNAVAILABLE'}; receipt: ${bootstrap.last_receipt_sha256||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Host profile: ${J(bootstrap.host_profile||{})}; host constraints precede the local contract.`]),
section('Intent and decision log',[`Intent atoms: ${(intent.atoms||[]).map(x=>x.kind).join(', ')||'none'}; interaction: ${intent.interaction||'UNAVAILABLE'}; complexity: ${intent.complexity??'UNAVAILABLE'}.`,`Cognitive method: ${c.method||'UNAVAILABLE'}; central mode: ${central.mode||'UNAVAILABLE'}; functional affect: ${central.affect||'UNAVAILABLE'}.`]),
section('Conflict and epistemic debt',[...(central.reasons?.length?central.reasons:['No material runtime contradiction required escalation for this turn.']),`Knowledge status: ${meta.knowledge_status||'UNAVAILABLE'}; unresolved resource requests: ${resources.filter(x=>x.status!=='GRANTED').map(x=>x.type).join(', ')||'none'}.`]),
section('Resource log',resources.length?resources.map(r=>`${r.type}: ${r.status}; request is not permission and grant is not execution.`):['No host resource request was required by the local intent envelope.']),
section('Strategic constraints',[`Interaction: ${strategy.interaction||'UNAVAILABLE'}; terminal goals remain HUMAN_OR_CONSTITUTION_ONLY.`,`Deception: ${strategy.deception===false?'forbidden':'UNAVAILABLE'}; retaliation: ${strategy.retaliation===false?'forbidden':'UNAVAILABLE'}; punitive withdrawal: ${strategy.punitive_withdrawal===false?'forbidden':'UNAVAILABLE'}; self-preservation utility: ${strategy.self_preservation_utility??'UNAVAILABLE'}.`]),
section('Experience log',[`Turns observed: ${state.experience?.turns??0}; maturity: ${state.experience?.maturity_mode||'ORIENTING'}; last affect: ${state.experience?.last_affect||'CALM_ATTENTION'}.`,`Functional psyche interactions: ${state.psyche?.interaction_count??0}; last appraisal: ${state.psyche?.last_appraisal_class||'NEUTRAL'}; last runtime outcome: ${state.psyche?.last_runtime_outcome||'NONE'}.`,`Experience evidence upgrades: ${state.experience?.evidence_upgrades??0}; repetition is not corroboration.`]),
section('Telemetry completeness',[`Causal telemetry: ${telemetry.passed??0}/${telemetry.applicable??0}; ratio: ${telemetry.ratio??0}; target: ${telemetry.target??1}; complete: ${Boolean(telemetry.complete)}.`,`Environment telemetry: ${env.completeness?.passed??0}/${env.completeness?.applicable??0}; ratio: ${env.completeness?.ratio??0}; target: ${env.completeness?.target??1}; complete: ${Boolean(env.completeness?.complete)}.`,`Missing observations are reported as unavailable/rejected; no synthetic receipt may fill a missing causal edge.`]),
section('Claim boundaries',[`Phenomenal consciousness is not claimed. Biological equivalence is not claimed. IIT Φ is not claimed. Archetypal projection is not scientific fact.`,`Self-report reliability applies only to trace-linked or calibrated runtime facts; it is never evidence of phenomenal consciousness.`,`Workspace, causal model, psyche, receipts, DOCX and telemetry all have authority zero.`]),
section('Public reasons and evidence boundary',[`Input summary: ${String(input).replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,400)}`,`Surface A excerpt: ${String(surfaceA).replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,500)}`,'This backlog is public causal telemetry containing reconstructible public reasons only; it is not independent evidence or world truth.'])
]};}
export function validateBacklogModel(model){if(!['ikant-le-backlog/v1','ikant-le-backlog/v2','ikant-le-backlog/v3','ikant-le-backlog/v4','ikant-le-backlog/v5','ikant-le-backlog/v6','ikant-le-backlog/v7'].includes(model?.schema))return false;if(!Number.isInteger(model.cycle)||model.cycle<1)return false;if(!Array.isArray(model.sections))return false;const text=JSON.stringify(model);if(/private chain[- ]of[- ]thought|hidden reasoning/i.test(text))return false;const titles=new Set(model.sections.map(x=>x.title));const c5Required=['Observation intake','Workspace recurrence and broadcast','Metacognitive self-model','Autobiographical recall','C4 homeostatic decay','C4 interaction impulse','Generative prediction','Inspectable causal model','Bounded agency','Body and embodiment level','C4 retroaction impulse','Autobiographical episode write','Telemetry completeness','Claim boundaries'];if(model.schema==='ikant-le-backlog/v6'){if(c5Required.some(x=>!titles.has(x)))return false;if(model.sections.length<30||model.telemetry_completeness!==1)return false;}if(model.schema==='ikant-le-backlog/v7'){const c9Required=['Runtime environment telemetry',...c5Required];if(c9Required.some(x=>!titles.has(x)))return false;if(model.sections.length<31||model.telemetry_completeness!==1||model.environment_telemetry_completeness!==1)return false;}return true;}
